Integrated ONLY the four collapse sheets from the rework-hexbarrow candidate-final on 2026-08-30; that lane's body sheets are refused, because the adversarial review found its s heading - the default facing - and its n heading collapse to a featureless bevelled grey slab with no wheels and no ram. Collapse is the one state this family never had: actors/hexbarrow/tN/collapse.png did not exist on disk, so these four keys were 4 of the 64 unresolved holds that make strictSelection throw for the entire game-v4 overlay. The collapse sheet is a single undirected row of four 128x112 frames, so it cannot carry the per-heading defect the body sheets were rejected for. Measured frame by frame: opaque mass falls monotonically 6210 -> 6002 -> 4714 -> 3304, the ground row is held at y=100 on every frame, the hex lens dies by f2, and it ends as a low scattered heap with a wheel disc lying flat. The other 20 keys of this family stay held. Lane spend 2 provider units (two south-identity img2img probes, both measured and rejected, zero retries); these four sheets are deterministic at 0 units.

Integrated the vault-quality candidate-final on 2026-08-30, replacing the strongbox-rework bytes previously pinned at these same paths. The owner rejected the shipped vault in the words "vault looks like wooden sauna"; four concepts were generated and judged, and the panel adopted concept D's IDENTITY decisions but rebuilt from the shipped family rather than shipping D's own pixels. The visible fix is a round steel vault door with a spoked handle on the front face, plus a gold spill at the base, over a full repaint. Measured here on idle frame 0, new against superseded: colours 53/55/55/54 against 31/32/32/32; blue-dominant cool pixels 0.00% against 9.42/11.26/11.90/10.86%; darkest outline luminance 1.2 against 6.2; largest single colour 7.2/7.4/5.3/6.1% of ink against 12.2/12.0/11.0/10.5%. RECORDED LIMIT: THE MASSING IS UNCHANGED. Same barrel-plank roof, same t3/t4 lean-to, same 1x1 footprint. Ink width is byte-for-byte identical at every tier (t1 55, t2 56, t3 62, t4 62 px) and opaque area moves by at most 0.34% (t4 2909 -> 2919). This is a restyle plus a vault door, not a new building; no later provenance or policy note may claim otherwise. Size law: 62 px t4 ink x 2 x WARE_WORLD_PRESENTATION.vault.sourceScale 0.59 = 73.2 world px on a 64 px plot = 1.14, inside the 1.15 rule. Lane spend 273 metered units, zero automatic retries; every semantically failed route was stopped rather than re-rolled. The superseded flat bytes at buildings/ware-ware_bld_vault_* remain on disk as an unselected alternate.
